title: Outbound message, schema ar-comms/0 (Overview C5, System Design 7). Staged by a worker at comms/staged/<M-id>.json, published by the runtime at comms/outbox/<seq:08d>-<M-id>.json. Versioning is additive within ar-comms/0: writers may add optional fields and new kinds, and readers must ignore unknown fields and unknown kinds. Known kinds: note, highlight, question, help_request, suggestion, decision, seen. Writers check the kind against that list (autoresearch.comms.envelope.KINDS); this schema does not, so a reader that validates with it accepts a newer kind.

rev.description: Workspace commit the reference is read at. A staged message may use "@result" (the commit its card merges as); the publisher replaces it with the merge SHA.

in_reply_to.description: Id of the message or inbound (I-id) this answers. An acknowledgement is a note with in_reply_to.

seq.description: Outbox only: the gap-free sequence number.

published_rev.description: Outbox only: canonical commit the message was published at (the merge SHA for a staged message).
